name: DHT22 / DHT11 temperature-humidity sensor
attribution: Pin geometry from wokwi/wokwi-elements (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2019 Uri Shaked and contributors). Mentor code is MIT; this data file keeps the license above.
frame: x_mm to the right along the top view from the left edge of outline_mm, y_mm DOWN from its top edge, z up from the top face; all in millimetres. Origin = top-left corner of the outline box as drawn.
notes: DHT11 has the same 4-pin 2.54 mm pinout (VCC, DATA, NC, GND); body is slightly smaller (outline here is the DHT22).
